limitations: Catalog review/calibration/performance values are templates generated by test hooks. Their public-experimental string and calibrated_request_bytes are not release qualification or measured calibration. Production catalog remains empty.
One prompt and seed per model, one success and one cancellation each. No formal P0/P1/P2/P3 or statistical performance/quality conclusion.
Public C API path exercised in a disposable Python process with cli_worker identity; not native CLI terminal protocol or App-driven real successful publication.
Engine free returned and sampler observed process exit; cancellation alone does not prove unsafe-drain/recovery/poison fault coverage or full M0 acceptance.
Swap/compression counters are sampler observations, not proof of model-exclusive attribution or a guaranteed zero-swap/hard memory cap.
Calibrated release policy and complete hybrid engine route remain unimplemented.
